Bring people together. Make it simple.

Join millions of organizers using SignUpGenius to plan smarter, save time, and rally their communities — all from one easy-to-use platform.

Get Started for Free

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Yes. SignUpGenius is free to start with no credit card required. The free plan includes all products and builders. Paid plans add more customization, higher communication limits, and the ability to remove ads from your sign ups.

No. Anyone you invite can claim a slot, register, or pay without creating an account. They click the link, complete their action, and they're done.

Yes. Payment collection is built directly into sign up sheets and every other product with no separate tool needed. Standard processing fees apply to payments collected.

SignUpGenius works for any type of organizing need. Popular use cases include volunteer scheduling, school events, team dues, spirit wear stores, fundraisers, ticketed events, group gifts, and digital waivers, all from one account.

Google Forms collects information. SignUpGenius coordinates people, with slot management, payment collection, automated reminders, and waitlists built in.

SignUpGenius is used by schools and PTAs, sports teams and booster clubs, nonprofits, faith communities, workplaces, and community organizations. Any group or individual that needs to coordinate people and collect money in one place.
